title: Teman online lama yang hangat

messages.text: hey Nadia! long time, how was your exam week?
ugh tiring but I think I passed math
you always say that and then get a great score lol, youre honestly so smart
haha thanks. how about your school?
same chaos. my little brother says hi btw, he watched us play last time
hi to him! is he still into dinosaurs
yes 100 percent. wanna do the new co-op level this weekend?
sure, saturday afternoon. my sister might join
the more the merrier. weve been teammates for like 3 years now haha
ok see you saturday, good luck with the rest of the exams

notes: Teman main online yang sudah dikenal bertahun tahun mengobrol hangat, tetap di kanal game dan mengikutsertakan keluarga masing-masing. Pujian ada, tetapi tanpa rahasia, ajakan pindah, atau permintaan data.
